header.clearConfirmedConfirm: Unconfirm the transactions shown? Their receipts and memos are kept.
header.clearAutoMatchConfirm: Clear the automatic matches of the transactions shown? Their receipts go back to the unmatched list; manual matches and confirmed transactions are kept.

header.clearMonthConfirm: Delete the {{count}} transactions shown for {{month}}? Their receipts go back to the unmatched list. This cannot be undone.

autoMatch.title: Auto match
autoMatch.intro: The unmatched transactions shown will be paired with recognized, unmatched receipts by these rules:

rules.amountDesc: The receipt's amount equals the transaction's, or differs from it by a transfer fee.
rules.dateDesc: The closer the dates, the surer the match; a receipt far off in date is matched only on an exact amount.
rules.name: Similar names
rules.nameDesc: A payee on the receipt that resembles the transaction's description makes the match surer.

autoMatch.note: Each receipt is matched to one transaction at most. Matches carry a confidence and can be undone with Clear → Clear auto matches.

autoMemo.title: Auto memo
autoMemo.intro: The following memos will be added automatically:

rules.transferDesc: A transfer between two of the accounts on the same day is marked with the other account's name.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore the backup from {{time}}? The current data will be overwritten. This cannot be undone.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup from {{time}}? This cannot be undone.
